datasets.name: EuroSAT dataset
datasets.verbatim: The EuroSAT open dataset [22], created for training and testing machine training models to effectively deal with the problem of classification of land use and vegetation cover systems on the basis of Sentinel-2 satellite images, was applied for primary testing of the proposed method. ... EuroSAT: Land Use and Land Cover Classification with Sentinel-2. Accessed: Aug. 1, 2020. [Online]. Available: https://github.com/phelber/EuroSAT

datasets.name: MapBox satellite imagery fragments
datasets.verbatim: Fragments of satellite images in the visual spectral range with the size of 32 × 32 px, algorithmically obtained through MapBox API in the 14th scale of tile representation 8. ... MapBox–API. Accessed: Aug. 1, 2020. [Online]. Available: https://docs.mapbox.com/api/

datasets.name: Digital landscape map of Mordovia GIS
datasets.verbatim: Fragments of a digital landscape map of Mordovia GIS, corresponding to square areas with the side of 1 km and discretized to 32 × 32 px screens.

datasets.name: Normalized altitude map
datasets.verbatim: Fragments of a normalized altitude map, plotted on the basis of Google Elevation API and having the shape of a 32 × 32 px square with the resolution of 10 meters per pixel.

methods.name: GeoSystemNet
methods.summary: A deep learning model that performs classification by analyzing both local area data and associated host geosystem data (multi-scale satellite imagery and synthetic maps). It uses a hierarchical feature extraction unit (based on depthwise separable 2D convolutions) and a feature merging module to concatenate hierarchical features before classification via a multilayer perceptron.
methods.verbatim: A software code, implementing GeoSystemNet model and a possibility to conduct experiments and comparative analysis, was written in Python with involvement of TensorFlow framework and Keras library [31]. ... GeoSystemNet on GitHub. Accessed: Aug. 28, 2020. [Online]. Available: https://github.com/yamashkinsa/geosystemnet

reproducibility_assessment: The EuroSAT dataset is linked and publicly available, but the landslide inventory and other regional datasets are not referenced or linked. The custom GeoSystemNet code is provided via a GitHub repository link.
